## Helper Functions

During the course, we will use a custom `check_answer()` function to validate lab output. You can find the source code below:

```r
# Custom validation function
check_answer <- function(student_val, expected_val, tolerance = 0.01) {
  if (is.numeric(student_val) && is.numeric(expected_val)) {
    if (abs(student_val - expected_val) <= tolerance) {
      message("Correct!")
    } else {
      warning("Incorrect. Try checking your group_by or summarise logic.")
    }
  } else {
    if (identical(student_val, expected_val)) {
      message("Correct!")
    } else {
      warning("Incorrect. Check your spelling or formatting.")
    }
  }
}
```
